profile_text.body:
# UC Berkeley / vLLM Team

The vLLM Team at UC Berkeley develops vLLM, a high-throughput inference engine for large language models. The project is open source and self-hosted, with no external data sharing. vLLM is available on GitHub as part of the broader open source community.

The team operates as a university lab rather than a for-profit entity. vLLM falls within the category of open source and self-hosted models for AI inference.
